name: Legacy items Tuple, unique-id Rename & prefixItems Migration
description: Introduces the initial four-node API Gateway pattern using legacy JSON Schema items tuples, refines relationship-type const endpoints, renames uniqueId to canonical unique-id (#46), and migrates tuple definitions to JSON Schema 2020-12 prefixItems (#79).

name: Typed Interfaces, Spectral Wiring & FINOS Namespace
description: Standardizes node-type classifications, adds explicit interface definitions on api-gateway and api-producer, aligns relationship wiring with Spectral rules, and migrates schema URIs from finos-labs to canonical finos namespaces.

name: Direct Consumer Identity Handshake
description: Adds the api-consumer-idp relationship so consumers authenticate directly against the Identity Provider before presenting tokens to api-gateway, while generalizing language-agnostic node names.

name: CALM Release Schema Standardization
description: Progressively upgrades pattern and interface schemas on api-gateway and api-producer from 2024-10 drafts through RC-1 candidates to stable CALM release specifications.
